# console-1.2 run lai8: I4 and I8 textures as one byte, IA4 and IA8 as two
# np-player.txt written by 1.3.0 build console-kit (the kit's files are not old settings files: the stale-settings guard leaves them as they are)
# tier 2, group hardware, route pipe, version payload 1.3, role ab
# Against pipefix. 80 % of the RGBA8 bytes of a match are GX I8 textures; this sends them as vitaGL's GL_INTENSITY (U8_RRRR). Same four numbers per texel: any difference in fonts, digits, shadows or fades fails the run (a swapped or missing alpha would show at once). Read [glmem]/[mem] video memory and the texture lines of the statistics.
# ---- route and logging: the same in every run ----

MSC_FRAME_TIMING=300
MSC_LAT=1
MSC_WATCH=1
MSC_WATCH_EVERY=600
MSC_VITA_CLOCK_POLICY=max
# ---- under test: nothing here means the default ----
MSC_VGX_LA88=2
MSC_DYNRES=0
